title: Standing Firm on Principle
paragraphs: When his manager suggested slightly exaggerating sales figures in a report to impress upper management, Karim felt immediate discomfort, even though the change seemed minor and unlikely to be discovered.

He politely explained that he was not comfortable presenting inaccurate numbers, even under pressure from someone senior to him, and offered instead to present the honest figures alongside a clear improvement plan.

His manager seemed slightly annoyed at first, but ultimately respected the pushback, and the honest report actually highlighted genuine progress that the exaggerated version would have unnecessarily hidden.

Reflecting later, Karim realized that standing firm on principle, even in a small and seemingly low-risk situation, mattered because these small moments gradually shape a person's larger character over time.
